changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard capitalization (GPT-3.5-turbo, Text-davinci-003). All extracted metadata was correct and relevant.
Normalized 'exact match' to 'Exact Match'. The paper uses exact match scores as the primary evaluation metric throughout the experiments.

The paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators after generation. Section 4.3.4 explores using LLMs to automatically construct Check and Match functions, but this is part of the generation methodology, not evaluation.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations. All evaluations are based on automatic exact match scores against ground truth answers.

overall_notes: This paper presents QAaP, a method for time-sensitive question answering by reframing QA as programming. The extraction quality was generally good. The paper focuses on factual question answering with temporal constraints, using GPT models for parsing and extraction, and evaluates primarily with exact match scores. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted.
